topics.title: Jack’s Sister & The Police Officer
topics.summary: During an interview, Jack mistakenly believes his deceased sister is his mother and engages in bizarre conversations with the interviewer about dead cops and Liza Marrier. A police officer becomes involved in the chaotic exchange as he attempts to intervene.

topics.title: Townshend & Waco - Teeth Obsession
topics.summary: During a news segment about the Waco siege aftermath, hosts engage in an extended discussion centered on one participant’s prominent teeth – specifically his large lips and overbite. They repeatedly reference this detail while interviewing medical examiners and another individual involved with the investigation, leading to humorous comparisons and personal observations regarding his mouth.

topics.title: Unusual Teeth and Extinction Theories
topics.summary: The segment discusses a man’s abnormally shaped teeth, initially described as ‘fake,’ prompting speculation about his origins and potential connection to extinct reptiles. The conversation explores theories including tetracycline poisoning, braces, and claims of the man being 45 feet tall with alien influence.

topics.title: Koresh Compound Investigation & Priest Scandal Update
topics.summary: Last week’s broadcast detailed the ongoing investigation into David Koresh and his followers at the Branch Davidian compound, including a former member recounting details of an unidentified man entering the site. The program then shifted to reporting accusations against a Catholic priest involving allegations of sexual abuse and a secret initiation club with teenage boys.

topics.title: Church Rehabilitation Investigation & Latoya Jackson Case
topics.summary: A man is under investigation for child abuse allegations, with discussions focusing on the church’s approach to rehabilitation and potential misconduct among clergy. Simultaneously, updates are given regarding the ongoing case involving Latoya Jackson's alleged assault, including her mother’s involvement and speculation about the circumstances.

topics.title: Arrow Injury During Mountain Men Anonymous Ritual
topics.summary: During a ritual initiation for ‘Mountain Men Anonymous’ in Portland, Oregon, a man was shot in the eye with an arrow after a member's bow malfunctioned during the apple-shooting exercise. Paramedics treated him until surgeons could remove damaged portions of his eyes following the incident.
